messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
మరియు ఆమె నా ముఖం ముందు కదలలేదు, అయితే ఆమె నా మార్గాన్ని ఎంతో అడ్డుకుంది, అది నేను తిరిగి రావడానికి తరచుగా తిరిగాను.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Telugu) | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------|--------| | e | Coordinating conjunction “And” | మరియు | “and” | OK | | non | Negation “did not” | కదలలేదు | “did not move” | OK | | mi | 1st‑person clitic (dative) – not rendered in the English reference (subject is “she”) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | si | Reflexive marker of *partire* | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | partia | Imperfect “move / depart” | కదలలేదు | “did not move” | OK | | dinanzi | Preposition “before / in front of” | ముందు | “in front of” | OK | | al | Contraction *a + il* (to + the) – definite article | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | volto | Noun “face” | ముఖం | “face” | OK | | anzi | Contrastive adverb “nay / rather” | అయితే | “but / rather” | OK | | ‘mpediva (impediva) | Imperfect “hindered” | అడ్డుకుంది | “hindered” | OK | | tanto | Degree adverb “so, to such an extent” | ఎంతో | “so, very” | OK | | il | Definite article “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | mio | Possessive adjective “my” | నా | “my” | OK | | cammino | Noun “road, path” (object of hindrance) | మార్గాన్ని | “road (ACC)” | OK | | ch’ (che) | Subordinating conjunction “that” | అది | “that” | OK | | i’ (io) | 1st‑person pronoun “I” | నేను | “I” | OK | | fui | Past‑historic of *essere* “was / had been” (auxiliary) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | per | Preposition “for, in order to” | రావడానికి | “to (return)” | OK | | ritornar | Infinitive “to return” | రావడానికి | “to return” | OK | | più | Comparative adverb “more” (used with *volte* → “oftentimes”) | తరచుగా | “often” | OK | | volte | Noun “times” (frequency) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | vòlto | Past‑historic “turned” | తిరిగాను | “I turned” | OK |
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: *mi, si, al, il, fui, volte* – Italian clitics, articles or auxiliary verbs that have no separate lexical counterpart in the Telugu rendering. - **OK**: All other mappings convey the intended meaning and respect Telugu grammar (case marking on *మార్గాన్ని*, verb agreement, etc.).
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected in the final Telugu sentences.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 34: - Original: మరియు ఆమె నా ముఖం ముందు కదలలేదు, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 35: - Original: అయితే ఆమె నా మార్గాన్ని ఎంతో అడ్డుకుంది, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 36: - Original: అది నేను తిరిగి రావడానికి తరచుగా తిరిగాను. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
